fullPassage: This is a NASA satellite image of the area near Wando, taken from space. NASA initially wondered what the black lines were and later discovered they are farms that grow gim. From this picture, you can guess that Korea is currently producing a lot of gim. It is relatively cheap and is frequently used in various Korean dishes, such as gimbap (a type of seaweed rice roll), gimjaban (roasted seaweed), and gimbugak (a type of crispy seaweed and rice chip). However, it used to be very expensive in the past, so not everyone could enjoy it as much as people can today. Gim in the Past. Gim seems to have been harvested in the past by women who walked into the sea during low tide to collect it from rocks. It was so precious and scarce that only royalty, like kings and queens, and the very wealthy had the privilege to afford it. During the Joseon period, ten sheets of gim were said to cost twenty cotton rolls, which cost a lot at the time. So you can imagine how expensive gim was. You might be wondering how gim became more affordable and readily available in recent years. Two figures are behind the striking popularity of gim today. It is widely believed that during the reign of King Injo, a man named Yeoik Gim succeeded in farming gim for the first time in history. He was taking a walk along the beach near the Seomjin River one day. He came across floating tree branches with some seaweed attached to them. He tasted the seaweed out of curiosity and found it to be delicious. The following year, he planted some poles along the sea where he had discovered the seaweed. Floating seaweed became entangled in the poles and grew there. This method allowed more people to enjoy gim, but it was not productive enough to cultivate as much gim as we consume today. To our surprise, a British scientist named Kathleen Drew-Baker, who had never been to Korea, contributed to making gim more widely available. While researching the annual life cycle of seaweed, she discovered how seaweed reproduces through spores, which function like seeds. Since her research, people have been able to produce gim in large quantities by artificially collecting spores and attaching them to cultivating frames. That is how gim became more affordable and widely available these days. Gim in the Present. Did you know that gim is also eaten in South Africa? In the first half of 2017, Korean gim accounted for approximately 43% of the South African market. Not surprisingly, Korea is the world's largest gim producer and exporter, dominating roughly 70% of the global gim market. According to Graph 1, gim exports overseas were only $100 million in 2010, but have steadily increased year after year, and reached $600 million in 2020. To where is gim exported? In 2019, the top three export destinations for Korean gim were the United States, Japan, and China. Furthermore, the number of export destinations is continuously increasing. According to Graph 2, gim was only exported to 64 countries in 2010, but by September 2021, gim exports had expanded to 112 countries worldwide. As more countries begin to eat gim, it is being consumed in new ways depending on the country. For example, in the United States, as Americans are paying more attention to gim as a healthy food, they enjoy roasted gim snacks with almonds and coconut added. Also, Thailand is producing its own gim snacks by importing gim from Korea and processing it with popular Thai flavors, such as tom yam kung (a sweet and sour flavor) and grilled squid. What is more, gim can be easily added to a variety of dishes. For example, the Culinary Institute of America, an internationally famous culinary university, published a recipe book titled Fabulous and Flavorful Gim. It includes gim recipes, such as gim flavored popcorn, gim fried chicken, and even gim ice cream. It is quite clear that gim is being used to create new and delicious types of food and to give new flavors to old favorites. Gim in the Future. The future of the gim industry appears bright, as global demand for gim is expected to rise in the coming years for a couple of reasons. First of all, gim is a highly valued product on the global market as a healthy food due to its nutritional properties. One hundred grams of gim contain sixteen times more dietary fiber than the same amount of cabbage, two times more protein than beans, and four times more calcium than milk. Gim's high nutrient content will make it a popular choice among consumers who are keenly interested in a healthy diet. Second, gim is environmentally friendly. A French magazine once published an article titled "Koreans who cook seaweed for Earth," which listed seaweed, including gim, as one of the most valuable foods for future generations, along with Spanish tomatoes, Latin American beans, and Canadian salmon. In fact, research shows that seaweed has been shown to capture and store CO2 as it grows. For example, one ton of seaweed absorbs three times as much CO2 as a maple tree. As demonstrated here, gim has many benefits. Who knows? There may come a day when gim is found on every dinner table around the world.

ch: 2017년 상반기에 한국산 김은 남아프리카공화국 시장의 약 43%를 차지했다.
한국은 세계 최대의 김 생산국이자 수출국으로 세계 김 시장의 약 70%를 장악하고 있다.
김의 해외 수출액은 2010년 1억 달러에서 2020년 6억 달러로 증가했다.
2019년 한국산 김의 주요 수출국 상위 3곳은 미국, 일본, 그리고 영국이었다.

questions.passage: As more countries begin to eat gim, it is being consumed in new ways depending on the country. For example, in the United States, as Americans are paying more attention to gim as a healthy food, they enjoy roasted gim snacks with almonds and coconut added. Also, Thailand is producing its own gim snacks by importing gim from Korea and processing it with popular Thai flavors, such as tom yam kung (a sweet and sour flavor) and grilled squid. What is more, gim can be easily added to a variety of dishes. For example, the Culinary Institute of America, an internationally famous culinary university, published a recipe book titled Fabulous and Flavorful Gim. It includes gim recipes, such as gim flavored popcorn, gim fried chicken, and even gim ice cream.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 나라별 김 소비 방식.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문 'Thailand is producing its own gim snacks by importing gim from Korea'에서 태국은 한국에서 김을 '수입한다'고 했으므로 '수출'은 불일치

❌ ② 본문 'published a recipe book titled Fabulous and Flavorful Gim'에서 김 요리책을 출간했다고 했으므로 불일치

✅ ③ 본문 'they enjoy roasted gim snacks with almonds and coconut added'와 일치 ←정답

❌ ④ 본문 'gim recipes, such as gim flavored popcorn, gim fried chicken'에서 팝콘·치킨에 쓰인다고 했으므로 '사용될 수 없다'는 불일치
det.tip: roasted gim snacks with almonds and coconut added(미국의 김 스낵)가 일치. 나머지는 본문과 반대입니다.

ch: 태국은 한국에 김을 수출하여 자국의 김 스낵을 생산한다.
The Culinary Institute of America는 김을 전혀 다루지 않는 전통 요리책만 출간했다.
미국인들은 아몬드와 코코넛이 첨가된 구운 김 스낵을 즐긴다.
김은 팝콘이나 프라이드치킨 같은 요리에는 사용될 수 없다.

questions.passage: Second, gim is environmentally friendly. A French magazine once published an article titled "Koreans who cook seaweed for Earth," which ①<u>listed</u> seaweed, including gim, as one of the most valuable foods for future generations, along with Spanish tomatoes, Latin American beans, and Canadian salmon. In fact, research shows that seaweed has been shown ②<u>to capture</u> and store CO2 as it grows. For example, one ton of seaweed absorbs three times as much CO2 as a maple tree. As ③<u>demonstrated</u> here, gim has many benefits. Who knows? There may come a day when gim ④<u>is finding</u> on every dinner table around the world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ is finding → is found: gim은 '발견되는' 대상이므로 수동태
det.analysis:
① listed: 'an article ~, which listed seaweed ~ as one of the most valuable foods'에서 which는 article을 받는 주격 관계대명사이고 listed는 그 정동사(과거)라 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② to capture: 'seaweed has been shown to capture and store CO2'에서 'be shown to + 동사원형' 구조라 to capture가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ demonstrated: 'As demonstrated here'는 'As (it is) demonstrated'의 분사구문(수동)이라 과거분사 demonstrated가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ is finding → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'a day when gim ___ on every dinner table'에서 김(gim)은 '발견되는' 대상이므로 수동태 is found로 써야 해요. is finding(능동 진행)은 '김이 발견한다'가 되어 틀려요. ❌ is finding은 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: 수동태: gim is found on every dinner table(김이 발견되다)

questions.passage: This method allowed more people to enjoy gim, but it was not productive enough to cultivate as much gim as we consume today. To our surprise, a British scientist named Kathleen Drew-Baker, who had never been to Korea, contributed to making gim more widely available. While researching the annual life cycle of seaweed, she discovered how seaweed reproduces through spores, which function like seeds. Since her research, people have been able to produce gim in large quantities by artificially collecting spores and attaching them to cultivating frames.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, Kathleen Drew-Baker는 해초가 씨앗과 같은 기능을 하는 '무엇'을 통해 번식한다는 것을 발견했는지, 그것을 나타내는 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 해초의 번식 수단.
det.analysis: 본문 'she discovered how seaweed reproduces through spores, which function like seeds.'에서 해초는 씨앗과 같은 기능을 하는 '포자(spores)'를 통해 번식한다고 했다. 따라서 답은 spores이다.
det.tip: reproduces through spores, which function like seeds에서 spores를 찾습니다.

questions.passage: First of all, gim is a highly valued product on the global market as a healthy food due to its nutritional properties. One hundred grams of gim contain sixteen times more dietary fiber than the same amount of cabbage, two times more protein than beans, and four times more calcium than milk. Gim's high nutrient content will make it a popular choice among consumers who are keenly interested in a healthy diet. Second, gim is environmentally friendly. A French magazine once published an article titled "Koreans who cook seaweed for Earth," which listed seaweed, including gim, as one of the most valuable foods for future generations, along with Spanish tomatoes, Latin American beans, and Canadian salmon. In fact, research shows that seaweed has been shown to capture and store CO2 as it grows.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 100g의 김은 우유보다 4배 더 많은 '무엇'을 함유한다고 했는지, 그 영양소를 나타내는 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 김에 풍부한 영양소.
det.analysis: 본문 'One hundred grams of gim contain ~ four times more calcium than milk.'에서 100g의 김은 우유보다 4배 더 많은 '칼슘(calcium)'을 함유한다고 했다. 따라서 답은 calcium이다.
det.tip: four times more calcium than milk에서 calcium을 찾습니다.

questions.passage: One hundred grams of gim contain sixteen times more dietary fiber than the same amount of cabbage, two times more protein than beans, and four times more calcium than milk. Gim's high nutrient content will make it a popular choice among consumers who are keenly __________ (interest) in a healthy diet. Second, gim is environmentally friendly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: interested (be interested in, 수동형 형용사).
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'consumers who are keenly ___ in a healthy diet'에서 'be interested in(~에 관심이 있다)'이라는 수동형 표현이다. 사람이 '관심을 갖게 되는' 대상이므로 과거분사형 interested로 바꿔야 한다. interest(흥미를 끌다)를 interested로 바꾸면 'who are keenly interested in(~에 매우 관심이 있는)'이 된다.
det.tip: be interested in: 관심이 있다 → interested

questions.passage: This is a NASA satellite image of the area near Wando, taken from space. NASA initially wondered what the black lines were and later discovered they are farms that grow gim. From this picture, you can guess that Korea is currently producing a lot of gim. It is relatively cheap and is frequently used in various Korean dishes, such as gimbap (a type of seaweed rice roll), gimjaban (roasted seaweed), and gimbugak (a type of crispy seaweed and rice chip). However, it used to be very expensive in the past, so not everyone could enjoy it as much as people can today. Gim in the Past. Gim seems to have been harvested in the past by women who walked into the sea during low tide to collect it from rocks. It was so precious and scarce that only royalty, like kings and queens, and the very wealthy had the privilege to afford it.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체를 아우르는 중심 소재.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 위성사진은 도입부의 소재일 뿐이고 해양 오염은 본문에 없음

❌ ② 조선 시대 왕실 소비는 '과거의 김' 일부 내용일 뿐 전체 주제가 아님

✅ ③ 글은 과거(귀한 음식)·현재(세계 수출)·미래(영양·친환경)로 이어지는 김의 가치와 세계적 확산을 다룸 ← 정답

❌ ④ CO2 흡수는 '미래의 김' 일부 근거일 뿐 '유일한 해결책'이라고 하지 않음
det.tip: Gim in the Past / Present / Future 구조 전체를 관통하는 것이 주제입니다.

ch: NASA 위성사진이 밝혀낸 해양 오염의 심각성
조선 시대 왕실의 사치품 소비 문화의 변화
과거부터 현재, 미래에 이르는 김(gim)의 가치와 세계적 확산
해초가 지구 온난화를 막는 유일한 해결책인 이유

However, it used to be very expensive in the past, so not everyone could enjoy it as much as people can today. Gim in the Past. Gim seems to have been harvested in the past by women who walked into the sea during low tide to collect it from rocks. questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글쓴이가 전하려는 핵심 메시지.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 과거에 비쌌던 것은 사실이나 지금은 저렴해졌다고 했으므로 '지금도 가장 귀한 음식'은 요지가 아님

✅ ② 본문은 김이 영양이 풍부하고(nutritional properties) 환경친화적이며(environmentally friendly) 세계적 수요가 늘어 'The future of the gim industry appears bright'라고 했으므로 요지로 적절 ← 정답

❌ ③ 양식 기술 완성·발전 여지에 관한 언급은 본문에 없음

❌ ④ 본문은 김이 남아프리카·미국·태국 등 세계로 확산된다고 했으므로 '오직 한국에서만'은 반대
det.tip: nutritional properties + environmentally friendly + bright future가 요지입니다.

ch: 김은 과거에 비싸서 왕족만 먹을 수 있었으므로 지금도 가장 귀한 음식이다.
김은 영양이 풍부하고 환경친화적이며 세계적으로 수요가 늘어 미래가 밝다.
김 양식 기술은 이미 완성되어 더 이상 발전할 여지가 없다.
김은 오직 한국에서만 소비되는 전통 식품이다.

questions.passage: To our surprise, a British scientist named Kathleen Drew-Baker, who had never been to Korea, contributed to making gim more widely available. While researching the annual life cycle of seaweed, she discovered how seaweed reproduces through spores, which function like seeds. Since her research, people have been able to produce gim in large quantities by artificially collecting spores and attaching them to cultivating frames. __________ these days. Gim in the Present.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"그것이 요즘 김이 더 저렴해지고 널리 보급된 방법이다." (10단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) affordable, and, available, became, gim, how, is, more, That, widely 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: That is how gim became more affordable and widely available
det.analysis:
'그것이 ~한 방법이다'는 'That is how + 주어 + 동사' 구문으로 시작해요: That + is + how.

무엇이 어떻게 되었는가 하면 '김이 ~되었다'예요: gim + became.

'더 저렴한'은 비교급 more affordable이고, became 뒤에 보어로 와요: became + more + affordable.

'그리고 널리 보급된'은 and로 이어 widely available로 마무리해요: and + widely + available.

순서대로 이으면 That / is / how / gim / became / more / affordable / and / widely / available 입니다.
det.tip: That is how + S + V ~: ~한 방법이다 / became + 비교급 보어

questions.wa: That is how gim became more affordable and widely available
accept: That is how gim became more affordable and widely available
